nodes.text: Come in. Mind the drying herbs. Sagewort on the left, moonbell on the right, and the smell in the middle is a tincture that is *supposed* to do that. Probably. Almost certainly.

choices.text: How did you come to Amberford?
Any advice for the road north?

nodes.text: Sagewort, moonbell, any honest herb you pull from the verges. Coin on the counter, no questions. Half this town's health walks in through that door in a forager's pocket. More than half, actually. I've counted.

Down the High Road, twelve years back. Eleven and a half, strictly. One book and a moonbell cutting wrapped in a stocking. Where from? _Further than the road goes._ The cutting took to the soil here. So did I. That's the whole answer you'll get.

Carry more tinctures than you think you need, and drink them *earlier* than you think you should. People die holding a full bottle. And past the Last Lamp, walk mornings. The old things up there sleep late.
Brewing formulas and the enchanter's treatises, folios on the shelf. Take your time with them.
